name: project_visual_media_gallery
title: Project Visual Media Gallery
description: Visual media section of a project page (replaces the old section_media_project): primary title ("Visual Media") + optional content_section_primary components (e.g. project_block_visual_and_paragraph), then project_visual_media_gallery_photo ("Photo Media Content") and project_visual_media_gallery_video ("Video Media Content"). The primary title renders only when something below it has output.
